feeds.title: Fast Bikes Magazine
feeds.description: Fast Bikes magazine is the definitive source for sportsbike nuts. Packed with hardcore riding, exhaustive new and used bike tests, riding advice, product reviews, project bikes, entertaining features and the world-famous Addiction.

feeds.title: Adventure Bike Rider
feeds.description: Adventure Bike Rider is the UK's favourite magazine for Adventure Sport, Dual Purpose and Touring, with the busiest website of any motorcycle magazine in the UK!

feeds.title: Mountain Bike Rider
feeds.description: If you ride a mountain bike, Mountain Bike Rider is for you. Mountain Bike Rider features trail guides, trail centres, bike and gear reviews, workshop advice. Find posts related to mountain bike rides.

feeds.title: Beginner Biker Adventures
feeds.description: Follow the trials and tribulations of a motorcycle newbie in London. From first learning to ride, to hardened commuter and beyond. Tips, product reviews and other two wheel shenanigans.

feeds.title: The Classic Motorcycle
feeds.description: The Classic Bike Hub gives you news, views, features and reviews from the UK's biggest classic motorcycle magazines. It is the essential website and app for any classic motorcycle lover.

feeds.title: MoreBikes
feeds.description: MoreBikes is the one-stop shop for all your motorcycling needs. Whether you're into the latest superbikes, the greatest tourers, the naughtiest nakeds, or the scootiest scooters - if you're a brand new person to the world of motorcycling or you've been riding a lifetime - we're exactly what you need for your two-wheeled life.

feeds.title: Superbike News » Motogp
feeds.description: Superbike News features the latest news, and images from the main Motorcycle Racing series around the world and also the latest Motorcycle Industry news from the main bike manufacturers and apparel, etc. Established in March 2001. Our goal is to keep you updated about all the racing events that take place across the world.

feeds.title: White Dalton Motorcycle Solicitors Blog
feeds.description: We are Britain's longest-running and most specialist motorcycle accident claims solicitors. Our focus allows us to provide the very best advice, support and outcome for motorcyclists who are injured in road traffic accidents. We are first and foremost hard-nosed, skilled, trial solicitors dedicated to fighting the motorcyclist's case and pride ourselves on giving you clear and frank advice.

feeds.title: Renchlist
feeds.description: Renchlist is a moto website dedicated to custom, classic and neo-retro motorcycles, plus vintage-inspired moto gear and culture.

feeds.title: Spartan Motorcycle Couriers Blog
feeds.description: Spartan Motorcycle Blogs covers a variety of motorbike subjects such as working as a motorcycle courier in the UK, motorbike riding skills and choosing a motorcycle. The motorbike blog contains help and advice for new and experienced motorbike riders. Spartan Motorcycle Couriers are professional Motorbike Couriers and are one of the fastest and safest same day delivery services serving the UK.

feeds.title: Alpha Motorcycle Training Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Alpha Motorcycle Training - a London based school providing high-quality motorcycle training courses at all levels. From CBT training A1 and A2 Restricted to DAS and Enhanced level tuition, we offer a range of courses at very affordable prices, enabling you to get unrivalled motorcycle training in London without breaking the bank.

feeds.title: North London Motorcycle Training Blog
feeds.description: The Motorcycle Training Blog will show all articles written by members of North London Motorcycle Training. Based in Edgware, North London Motorcycle Training has nearly 40 years of experience in offering high-quality motorbike and scooter lessons. Whether you have ridden a motorbike before or it's your first time on powered wheels, we'll make sure that you receive a first-class motorcycle training service.

feeds.title: British Motorcyclists Federation
feeds.description: The BMF is one of the largest rider groups in the world and has existed since the 1960s. We are a non-profit organisation run by elected volunteers, providing motorcyclists with a voice through specialist lobbyists and a network of volunteers across the UK. The BMF successfully campaigns on issues that directly affect the liberty, safety and security of motorcyclists.

feeds.title: Saffy Sprocket
feeds.description: Saffy shares useful tips about biking, her long-distance trips and reviews bikes, gears. She loves to go on adventures on her two wheels. Saffy Sprocket is a North England-based bike youtuber and motorcycle maniac.

feeds.title: Motorcycle Sports
feeds.description: Motorcycle Sports brings you the best of the wheeled world, giving you the latest news on your favorite races, and direct access to our best content.

feeds.title: THE S ROAD
feeds.description: A motorbike blog from a woman rider in London with a touch of travel and lifestyle content.

feeds.title: Halfords » Motorcycle
feeds.description: If you're a motorcycle lover then you'll love our articles on topics such as must-have motorcycle accessories, how to keep your motorcycle sparkling clean and how to keep your motorcycle safe at home and away. Halfords is the UK's leading retailer of motoring, cycling and leisure products and services.

feeds.title: Tru-Tension
feeds.description: Keep up to date with all the latest news from Tru-Tension, specialists in manufacturing innovative maintenance products for motorcycles, bikes and karts. Tru-Tension designs, manufacture and sell a range of high-quality maintenance solutions.

feeds.title: Visordown
feeds.description: The UK's No.1 motorcycle news, reviews and road tests resource - Visordown is the world's fastest growing motorcycle website with all the latest motorbikes.

feeds.title: Bikesure Blog
feeds.description: Bikesure helps you find the best quotations for the insurance of your motorcycle or a scooter without compromising on the quality. It has been in the forefront of providing affordable insurance cover to 2 wheelers as well as four wheelers of any kind and can give you offers that are tailormade to your needs.

feeds.title: We Buy Any Bike
feeds.description: As a group of motorcycle enthusiasts who have had a great deal of pleasure from the biking community over the years, we know how to make selling your motorbike easy. The WeBuyAnyBike blog provides lots of interesting and exciting articles for bikers - statistics, tips, motorcycling history and more.
